scope: Separate the historical beta-reward comparison, deployment timestep sensitivity, and the newly requested matched 400 Hz beta-off training.
beta_off_definition: Set reward_weights.sideslip from 2.0 to exactly 0.0. Do not set the reference beta to zero, remove turning/speed/yaw targets, or remove wheel XY tracking.

existing_beta_pair.training_confound: ON had no setup-smoke steps and used GPU 2; OFF had eight zero-action setup steps and used GPU 7. One seed per arm; descriptive comparison, not a causal beta-only estimate.

same_checkpoint_timestep_diagnostic.intervention: Same frozen 200 Hz-trained actor deployed at physics/explicit-PD 200 versus 400 Hz; policy remains 50 Hz. Closed-loop actions may differ. No training-frequency intervention or beta ablation.
same_checkpoint_timestep_diagnostic.interpretation: Nominal XY RMSE changes by about 1 mm, but common-band body jitter changes by -18.9% and neither-wheel measured load duty increases by 4.30 percentage points. Similar XY tracking does not establish contact/dynamics equivalence or a negligible training-frequency effect.

cross_recipe_comparison.allowed: Show measured performance side by side with physics/training clocks, action-rate and DR labelled.
cross_recipe_comparison.not_allowed: Attribute old-200 beta-off versus new-400 beta-on differences to beta alone.
additional_confounds: historical BeyondMimic static/dynamic DR versus shared representable MJLab-style DR
different training integration/PD rate and trained checkpoints

approved_new_beta_off_scope.initial_validation: Each completed beta-off actor at mu=0.7 in PhysX and native CPU MuJoCo; no claim of direct GPU MJWarp validation.

camera_user_choice: For all new animations use one fixed distance, fixed world orientation/FOV and fixed root-relative translation offset throughout each video. No per-frame zoom. Fixed-world XY maps preserve trajectory offsets.
